title.en: Render/BVH rolling schedule log (S1 review notes, S2a review start, S2b GPU window)

intent.zh: 维护 docs/development-evidence/render-bvh-precheck/ 的滚动推进表：记录 S1 复核 verified（0b63829）与 QA 两条建议（S3 前补 mjwarp.model.render-model / mjwarp.io.render 两个新叶子模块的 layout order/apis；src/model/render.rs 已 500 行，任何加功能先拆文件）；记录 Chief 批准 S2a 复核 now start；记录 S2b in_progress 与 90 分钟独占 GPU 窗口、S2b 复核另开 45 分钟。不改产品源码/测试/fixtures，不改切片验收/容差语义。
intent.en: Maintain the rolling tracking table under docs/development-evidence/render-bvh-precheck/: record S1 review verified (0b63829) and QA's two notes (before S3, add layout order/apis for the new leaf modules mjwarp.model.render-model and mjwarp.io.render; src/model/render.rs is exactly 500 lines so any feature addition must split the file first); record Chief's approval for S2a review to start now; record S2b in_progress with a 90-minute exclusive GPU window and a separate 45-minute window for S2b review. No product source/test/fixture changes and no change to slice acceptance or tolerances.

acceptance: 推进表记录 S1 复核 verified（0b63829）与 6/6 结论，并登记 QA 两条建议：S3 前补两个新叶子模块的 layout order/apis；src/model/render.rs 500 行棘轮，后续加功能先拆文件。
推进表记录 S2a 复核已获 Chief 批准 now start（CPU/无 GPU），S2b in_progress，S2b 90 分钟独占 GPU 窗口与 S2b 复核 45 分钟独立窗口。
只改 docs/development-evidence/render-bvh-precheck/ 文档；不改 src/tests/fixtures/Cargo.*、不改切片验收/容差；plan.json JSON 合法且 task_id 仍为 precheck 任务。
